place: a flat city rooftop at night

hero.name: Max
hero.look: a tired man in his late twenties in a creased work shirt, unshaven

soul.diary: Got let go from the warehouse on Friday and still have not told anyone.
wants: to stop pretending everything is fine
soul.past_dream: Stairs that kept going up and a door always one floor higher.

situation_hero: you just woke up on a rooftop at night and five people are up here looking at you

actors.name: Dan
actors.look: a breathless young man in a rain-soaked hoodie
actors.persona: Dan: he says he is Max's old friend and he ran up eleven floors to get Max away from the edge.

actors.name: Maya
actors.look: a young woman in a thin coat over pyjamas
actors.persona: Maya: Max's younger sister, furious and frightened, she wants him to say out loud what happened on Friday.

actors.name: neighbor
actors.look: a small elderly woman in a quilted housecoat holding a tin of grain
actors.persona: The neighbor from the third floor: she comes up every night to feed the pigeons and talks about the birds and the wind.

actors.name: watchman
actors.look: a stooped old man in a reflective vest with a torch
actors.persona: The night watchman: he wants everyone off his roof before his shift ends and keeps naming the rules.

actors.name: kid
actors.look: a boy of nine in a too-big jacket holding a kite
actors.persona: The kid from the top floor: he came up to fly his kite and asks the questions nobody else dares to.
